title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: Credit Limit and Spending Guidelines
summary: This document explains Business Bronze Rewards Card credit limits (initial at least $10,000 up to $50,000), underwriting requirements (credit score at least 660; Business PAYDEX 20+ if available), responsible spending guidance, a 2.75% foreign transaction fee for non‑US/non‑USD purchases, and how to request a credit line review/credit line increase.
faqs: What is the minimum and maximum initial credit limit for the Business Bronze Rewards Card?
What credit score or Business PAYDEX score do I need for underwriting?
Are there any foreign transaction fees for purchases outside the United States or with non‑USD merchants? If so, what percentage?
How should I manage spending to avoid declines and keep within my credit limit?
When and how can I request a credit line increase or credit line review?
